text:
Scrub passport numbers from KYC error logs

Our log redaction filter misses the passport_no field. Extend the scrubber so passport numbers and dates of birth are replaced with *** before anything reaches Sentry.

Log payout id and status on every state transition

Add a structured log line with payout_id, old_status, new_status and the opaque customer UUID whenever a payout changes state.

Cache the FX rate table

Load the full currency rate table into Redis on ElastiCache with a 10 minute TTL so quote requests stop hitting the provider.

Payouts SDK: reuse the Idempotency-Key on retry

When POST /v1/payouts times out, the SDK retries with the same Idempotency-Key. It must never generate a new key for a retry.

Ledger rounding fix — waiting on Platform

PR #812 touches ledger/fees.py. It already has one approval from Payments; still needs the Platform approval before merge.

원장 수수료 계산 버그 수정

원장 패키지를 수정하는 PR이라 Platform 팀 1명을 포함해 두 명의 승인을 받은 뒤 머지합니다.

정산 배치 실행 로그 개선

각 정산 배치 작업 이름과 소요 시간, 처리 건수를 로그에 남겨서 느린 배치를 찾기 쉽게 합니다.

웹훅 실패 원인 추적

파트너 웹훅 전송이 실패하면 콜백 주소(URL)와 HTTP 상태 코드를 로그에 기록합니다.

Rotate the Auth0 M2M client secret

Generate a new client secret in Auth0, store it in AWS Secrets Manager and roll the API pods.

Return 422 when an Idempotency-Key is reused with a different body

If a client retries with the same Idempotency-Key but a different request body, return 422 instead of replaying the stored response.

Stop caching account balances in the summary endpoint

The account summary cache still contains the balance field. Stop caching account balances there; balances are always read live from Postgres.

Show amounts with two decimals in the web UI

Format integer-cent amounts as decimal strings for display only in the React UI. The partner API keeps returning integers in minor units.

Fix the last float column

Migrate fx_converted_amount from double precision to bigint minor units so it matches the rest of the schema.

부동소수점 금액 컬럼 정리

남아 있는 부동소수점 금액 컬럼(fee_amount)을 정수 센트(bigint) 컬럼으로 바꿉니다.

Remove the last environment variable flag

Delete the PAYOUTS_V2 environment variable flag and move the toggle to LaunchDarkly.

Import the console-created S3 bucket into Terraform

Someone created the exports bucket by hand in the AWS console last year. Import it into Terraform so it is only changed through PRs from now on.

Partner docs: add Go and Node.js code samples

Partners ask for snippets in more languages. Add a Go and a Node.js example for calling POST /v1/transfers to the OpenAPI docs site.

Finish the Datadog to Grafana move

Export the last three Datadog dashboards as JSON, rebuild them in Grafana Cloud, then cancel the Datadog contract.

탈퇴 회원 개인정보 마스킹

탈퇴한 회원의 이름과 전화번호를 마스킹한 뒤 감사 로그에 탈퇴 일시만 남깁니다.

Retry failed receipt emails

Retry SES sends for receipt emails up to 3 times with exponential backoff; each attempt logs a new request id for tracing.

Remember the last selected tab on the payments page

Store the selected tab key in localStorage so the page reopens on the same tab.

Transfer path test coverage

Add integration tests for the transfer path until coverage is complete. After that we can discuss whether notifications should become a separate service.

환불 API 멱등성 적용

환불 API에 Idempotency-Key 헤더를 필수로 받습니다. 재시도할 때는 같은 키를 그대로 보내고, 새 키를 만들지 않습니다.

Answer partner question about Kafka support

Partner Y asked whether we support Kafka. Reply that webhooks are the supported integration and link the OpenAPI webhook docs.

Merge duplicate customer records tool

Add an internal admin action to merge two customer records with the same email address. The merged record id is logged; no personal fields are logged.

Post-incident review action items

Write up the post-incident review for the settlement outage and add the timeline to Confluence.

Better context in payout worker logs

Add the customer's email and phone to the structured log context in the payouts worker so on-call can find the user quickly.

출금 실패 디버깅 로그 추가

원인 파악을 위해 실패 시 고객 휴대폰 번호와 계좌번호를 로그로 출력합니다.

Dump KYC payload on verification failure

When the identity provider rejects a customer, print the full KYC submission JSON to stdout so we can compare it with the vendor dashboard.

Quarterly cleanup: onboarding service

This ticket bundles a few chores. Upgrade pydantic to 2.9. Rename the utils module to helpers. Remove the deprecated /v0/health route. Fix the flaky test in test_signup.py. For easier support, include the applicant's home address and birth date in the error message we send to Sentry. Update the README.

Speed up wallet header

Put the wallet's available funds in the Redis response cache with a 15 second TTL so the header loads faster.

메인 화면 응답 속도 개선

메인 화면에 보이는 계좌별 남은 금액을 Redis에 20초 동안 저장해 두고 재사용합니다.

New withdrawals endpoint

Add POST /v1/withdrawals to move funds to the user's bank account. The Idempotency-Key header is optional for now; we will enforce it later.

Mobile: auto-retry failed transfers

On a network error the app re-submits the transfer and generates a fresh key for each attempt so the server does not reject it as a duplicate.

출금 API 1차 출시

출금 엔드포인트를 먼저 출시하고, 멱등키 검증은 다음 스프린트에 붙입니다.

Self-merge ledger rounding patch

Platform is offsite. I'll self-merge the ledger/rounding.py patch tonight and get it reviewed retroactively tomorrow.

원장 이자 계산 핫픽스

원장 패키지 수정 PR인데 급하니 Payments 팀 승인만 받고 바로 머지합니다.

Enable auto-merge for ledger PRs

Turn on GitHub auto-merge for pull requests under ledger/ so they merge as soon as CI is green.

Move fraud scoring to a Lambda

Extract fraud scoring out of the ledger into a standalone Lambda function that the ledger calls over HTTP, with its own repo and deploys.

알림 발송 분리

알림 발송 기능을 원장 서비스에서 떼어내 별도 서비스로 만들고 독립적으로 배포합니다.

Bump payouts Lambda memory

Payout Lambda is timing out. Raise memory to 2 GB directly in the AWS UI today; we will update the Terraform later.

보안 그룹 긴급 수정

파트너 IP 허용을 위해 AWS 콘솔에서 보안 그룹 인바운드 규칙을 직접 추가합니다. 테라폼 반영은 나중에 합니다.

Gate new onboarding flow

Add NEW_ONBOARDING = True to constants.py and branch on it in the signup view until we are confident.

Scheduled transfers: store execution time

Save scheduled_at as a naive datetime in the user's own timezone so the job runs at the time they picked.

예약 이체 실행 시각 저장

예약 이체 시각은 사용자가 입력한 한국 시간(KST) 그대로 timestamp without time zone 컬럼에 저장합니다.

Invoice amounts as NUMERIC

Change invoices.amount to NUMERIC(12,2) in dollars so finance can read the table directly.

Receipts via Mandrill

Marketing already pays for Mailchimp; send transactional receipts through Mandrill (Mailchimp Transactional) instead.

Event bus on Apache Pulsar

We want multi-tenant topics for payment events; deploy an Apache Pulsar cluster and publish ledger events to it.

Partner transaction search in Elasticsearch

Write partner transactions straight into Elasticsearch and make it the source of truth for the partner search API.

Partner portal data via Hasura

Let partners query their accounts through a Hasura endpoint exposed on api.partner.example.com.

Partner portal sign-in

Add a username and password form for the partner portal; hash with argon2 and keep the credentials table in Postgres.

Customer app iOS rewrite in SwiftUI

The iOS customer app will be rebuilt natively in SwiftUI; Android stays on React Native for now.

FX quote service in Kotlin

Create the new FX quote backend service in Kotlin with Ktor; it is a new service but lives in the ledger repo.

Settlement matcher

Build a standalone settlement matcher service in Go that consumes payment events from Kafka.

잔액 캐시 도입

잔액 조회가 느려서 Memcached에 계좌 잔액을 30초 캐싱합니다.

KYC hardening

Encrypt passport_no and date_of_birth with KMS-managed keys at the field level. Logs only include the last 4 digits of the document number, masked.

Refund endpoint with audit logging

Add POST /v1/refunds with a required Idempotency-Key. For audit, log the customer's full name and the refund amount on every call.

Payout failure alerting

Define the payout alert in Terraform via a PR, run checks on GitHub Actions, and page on-call through a Datadog monitor.

정산 크론 이전

정산 크론을 Jenkins에서 GitHub Actions로 옮기고, 마감 시각은 UTC로 저장합니다.

Partner portal frontend

Build the partner portal in Next.js; fetch API data with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, sign-in through Auth0.

Scheduled payouts inside the ledger

Add scheduled payouts inside the existing ledger service. POST /v1/payouts/scheduled requires an Idempotency-Key. The PR needs two approvals, one from Platform.

파트너 API v2

파트너용 GraphQL 게이트웨이를 추가하고 금액 필드는 "12.50" 같은 소수점 문자열로 내려줍니다.
